facts.fact: Adwave's own page states that campaigns start from $30 per day with no contracts.
Adwave's related towing company guide says tow company ad budgets look like from $30 per day.
facts.quote: what budgets look like from $30/day, and the ad rules to follow

facts.fact: Adwave says its campaigns run on Facebook, Instagram, Google, Reddit, web, mobile, and TV, and that TikTok runs only when the user turns it on in Customize and connects a TikTok account.
facts.quote: Facebook, Instagram, Google, Reddit, web, mobile, and TV. TikTok runs when you turn it on in Customize and connect your TikTok account

facts.fact: Adwave says users can review and edit generated ads before they launch.
facts.quote: Review and edit them before you launch.

facts.fact: Adwave says users pick a daily budget when they are ready to launch, after the free website analysis.
facts.quote: Pick a daily budget when you are ready.
